ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The lower part of the figure is the ground, the upper part is labeled with things such as "directed toward outer space", and the center is a schematic of the atmosphere and absorption and radiation processes. It can be seen that number 4 represents solar radiation entering from the direction of the Sun, number 3 represents ground radiation emitted upward from the ground, number 1 is an arrow slanting downward from the atmosphere toward the ground, and number 2 is located at the radiation arrow where the atmosphere emits upward toward outer space. Reasoning: The question asks for the numerical code of "atmospheric radiation in the figure". After the atmosphere absorbs ground radiation, it emits longwave radiation outward; the part directed upward toward outer space is called atmospheric radiation, and the part directed downward toward the ground is called atmospheric counter-radiation. Therefore atmospheric radiation in the figure corresponds to number 2.
